description: Elections Commission - Declare that L. Y. A. G. Sanjeewa as a member of the Galle Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Galle Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it pertains to electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
